675.q: Tomorrow I will go to see the dentist.
675.nat: Tomorrow I'm going to the dentist.

678.q: If you're thinking of starting swimming, it's better to learn gradually first.
678.nat: If you're thinking of starting swimming, best to ease into it.

680.q: Tonight we ought to sleep a bit early.
680.nat: We should get an early night tonight.

681.q: On this day off, are you going to go anywhere?
681.nat: Are you going anywhere this holiday?

682.q: I can't go today — another time.
682.nat: I can't make it today — another time.

683.q: If I'm not tied up with work, this evening I will go to see you.
683.nat: If I'm not tied up with work, I'll come over this evening.

685.q: May we change it to some other day, is that OK? That day isn't convenient.
685.nat: Could we change it to another day? That day isn't convenient.

687.q: I'm really sorry — as it happens I have to ask to cancel.
687.nat: I'm so sorry — I'm going to have to cancel.

688.q: As it happens there's something urgent — may I postpone the appointment a bit, is that OK?
688.nat: Something urgent's come up — could we postpone?

689.q: Sure, of course, no problem — we can rearrange later, that's fine too.
689.nat: Sure, no problem — we can just rearrange.

690.q: Tomorrow our arrangement is still the same as before, right?
690.nat: We're still on for tomorrow, right?

691.q: Sorry — I have changed my mind already; not going would be better.
691.nat: Sorry — I've changed my mind, I'd rather not go.

692.q: I promise that next time I will manage to go, definitely.
692.nat: I promise I'll definitely make it next time.

693.q: What time shall we arrange to meet? Are you free at two in the afternoon or three in the afternoon?
693.nat: What time shall we meet? Are you free at two or three?

694.q: In that case let's meet at two in the afternoon — see you in front of the shop.
694.nat: Two it is, then — see you out front.

695.q: That day I'm tied up — could you go instead?
695.nat: I'm tied up that day — could you go in my place?

696.q: Could I trouble you to confirm that you will come or not?
696.nat: Could you kindly confirm whether you're coming?

697.q: I'm intending to make it finished by tomorrow — would that be possible?
697.nat: I'm hoping to get it done by tomorrow — is that doable?

698.q: And what about you? Do you have plans — are you going to do anything special?
698.nat: And what about you? Any special plans?

699.q: Any day is fine — it depends on you, whatever is convenient.
699.nat: Any day's fine — whatever suits you.

700.q: These days I probably can't go anywhere, I'm afraid — work is really busy.
700.nat: I won't be able to go anywhere for a while, I'm afraid — work's hectic.

701.q: Are you going to go together? Tell me in time beforehand, in case I need to book a spot.
701.nat: Are you coming along? Let me know in good time — in case I need to book a spot.

702.q: Once you have decided, just go ahead and let me know.
702.nat: Once you've decided, just let me know, yeah.
